answer: An agent economy indexing reef sonar and dune lidar can deter Sybils with proof of replication. Each node binds its keypair to a uniquely encoded dataset replica via a slow sequential graph and answers random Merkle audits within tight latency bounds, blocking adversaries from backing multiple accounts with one mirror. Spawning fake identities incurs verifiable disk capacity and I/O costs per account. However, cloud operators with vast idle storage can still buy outsized weight cheaply.
